MOD = 1000000007
MAX_K = 33

class Matrix:
    def __init__(self):
        self.a = [[0]*(MAX_K+1) for _ in range(MAX_K+1)]

def multiply(m1, m2, size):
    result = Matrix()
    for i in range(size+1):
        for j in range(size+1):
            total = 0
            for p in range(size+1):
                total += m1.a[i][p] * m2.a[p][j]
            result.a[i][j] = total % MOD
    return result

def main():
    n, k = map(int, input().split())

    ans = Matrix()
    for i in range(k+1):
        ans.a[i][i] = 1

    t = [Matrix() for _ in range(k)]
    for p in range(k):
        for i in range(k+1):
            for j in range(k+1):
                t[p].a[i][j] = 1 if (i == j or i == p) else 0

    bits = []
    temp = n
    while temp > 0:
        bits.append(temp % k)
        temp //=k
    bits.append(0)
    # partial sum from the right
    for i in range(len(bits)-2, -1, -1):
        bits[i] += bits[i+1]

    p = 0
    while p + 1 < len(bits):
        for i in range(bits[p]-1, bits[p+1]-1, -1):
            ans = multiply(t[i % k], ans, k)
        pre = [Matrix() for _ in range(k)]
        suf = [Matrix() for _ in range(k)]
        pre[0] = t[0]
        for i in range(1, k):
            pre[i] = multiply(pre[i-1], t[i], k)
        suf[k-1] = t[k-1]
        for i in range(k-2, -1, -1):
            suf[i] = multiply(t[i], suf[i+1], k)
        ans = multiply(suf[0], ans, k)
        for i in range(1, k):
            ans = multiply(suf[i], pre[i-1], k)
        p += 1

    total = 0
    for i in range(k+1):
        total += ans.a[i][k]
    print(total % MOD)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
